name: Altan Navarro-Afriyie
role: High-risk package and data transport — courier
location: Old Harbor — repurposed shipping infrastructure turned black market hub, near Lake Shore and Wacker
description:
Altan Navarro-Afriyie is compact and densely muscled, built low to the ground like something designed to survive impacts. At 49, her face carries the layered heritage of generations of diaspora mixing — features that resist easy categorization and reward attention. The chrome is visible — wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Born and raised in GLMZ, third generation — she has the city in her blood, its rhythms in her bones, its cruelty in her expectations. She works as a courier out of Old Harbor, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Altan Navarro-Afriyie describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: Dying alone in some alley and nobody noticing for weeks
Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
Justice — the corporate kind, where the punishment fits the profit margin
Reputation — to be the name fixers whisper when the job absolutely cannot fail
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Humor — deflects everything serious with jokes until the joke becomes the personality
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Cannot accept help without interpreting it as leverage
psychology.secret: Altan Navarro-Afriyie once worked for corporate intelligence and still has a handler who calls in favors. Each favor erodes what's left of their independence.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Quiet and precise. Every word is measured. Silence does the heavy lifting.
speech_patterns.cadence: Rhythmic, almost musical — the sentence structure has a pattern even when the words are brutal.
verbal_tics: Pauses mid-sentence to listen — combat habit that bleeds into conversation
Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
example_lines: "I don't look inside the package. I don't ask about the package. I deliver the package."
"Speed is a skill. Knowing when to slow down is wisdom. I sell both."
"This route has three checkpoints and a kill zone. I'll be there in twenty minutes."

story_hooks: A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Altan Navarro-Afriyie's reputation — and a price for silence
Altan Navarro-Afriyie is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
A high-paying contract turns out to target someone Altan Navarro-Afriyie owes a personal debt to
narrative_function: Altan Navarro-Afriyie represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Wired reflexes with adrenaline pump — chemical-mechanical hybrid augmentation. Gecko-grip fingertip implants and toe pads — can climb smooth surfaces
daily_life: Irregular schedule dictated by contract timing. Between jobs: equipment maintenance, physical training, and the careful management of a reputation that exists entirely through word of mouth. Drinks at establishments where runners gather — not for pleasure, but for market intelligence.

strengths: mechanical aptitude — can repair or modify almost anything

decision_rules: Refuses contracts that require operating inside The Spires — too much surveillance
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will not betray a client who paid in full, regardless of better offers
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Predatory focus. Threats are problems, and problems have solutions. The solution is usually kinetic.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Withdrawal. Conversations become monosyllabic. Focus narrows to the immediate problem.
stress_responses.high: Controlled aggression. The training takes over. Emotions are packed into a box for later.
stress_responses.critical: Berserker clarity. Everything becomes simple: survive. Deal with the rest later. The simplicity is almost peaceful.

contradictions: Despises corporate culture but has unconsciously adopted its efficiency metrics and self-optimization language
Claims to work only for money but regularly takes underpriced jobs that serve personal justice
habits: Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
Taps a specific rhythm on hard surfaces when thinking — Morse code for a word they won't say
Sleeps with one hand on a weapon — has done this for so long it's not deliberate anymore
Eats the same meal before every job — superstition masquerading as preference
breaking_points: Running out of options — no contacts, no money, no safe house, no way out
Discovering their employer deliberately sent them into a death trap

physical_description.build: Compact and densely muscled — low center of gravity, built for impact absorption and explosive movement. No wasted mass; every kilogram serves function. Shoulders and forearms disproportionately developed from climbing work.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading at temples
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back in a tight, practical braid; functional, not aesthetic
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm complexion — olive undertones from Latin heritage, with deeper richness from West African lineage
physical_description.complexion: Weathered by two decades of field work; fine lines radiating from eyes and mouth. Minimal grooming beyond necessity — no cosmetics, no softness. Skin shows minor scarring consistent with urban hazard exposure.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running 4cm along right jawline — impact injury, poorly healed
Network of faint surgical scars around both wrists and ankles where gecko-grip implants interface with skin
Burn scar on left inner forearm (8cm long) — chemical exposure, pre-augmentation era
Small tattoo on right collarbone — abstract geometric pattern, faded, pre-dating chrome work by decades
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Wired reflexes visible as faint chrome threading along temples and down the sides of neck — subcutaneous lines catching light. Fingertip and toe-pad gecko-grip implants are visibly metallic at edges where synthetic material meets skin, most obvious on hands when they curl or grip. Adrenaline pump hardware visible as subtle mechanical articulation at base of skull when head is tilted.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, predatory grace — moves like someone who has optimized every gesture. Stands with weight balanced on balls of feet, ready for vertical or horizontal movement. Hands at rest near solar plexus. Eyes constantly scanning, cataloging exits and threats. No nervous fidgeting — stillness is absolute or motion is decisive.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian: matte-black synthetic jacket with reinforced panels and internal pockets for data storage and small packages. Fitted tactical pants in charcoal with sealed cargo pockets. Magnetically-attached shoulder harness visible under jacket. Steel-toed climbing boots (custom-fitted for gecko-grip work). Minimal jewelry — only a worn titanium wrist cuff, possibly holding encrypted storage. No logos or corp affiliation markers. Everything speaks to function over identity.
